acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata, lockfile, and all current release/versioning documents consistently declare v0.2.71; v0.2.70 remains the previous public baseline and no failed tag is reused.
Release CI from the reviewed default branch produces the five-target public artifact set with manifest, SHA256SUMS, SBOM, provenance, attestation, and Runtime identity bindings.
Post-release acceptance uses only downloaded public v0.2.71 artifacts in isolated roots, proves cleanup and forbidden-root isolation, and validates the same binary for self-governance.
The WI-552 comparison and WI-553 documentation promotion remain closed and promoted; no active Work Item, stale branch, or untracked closure artifact remains before release.
goal: 生成可审计的 v0.2.71 发布基线，确保包身份、三语文档、CI、公开资产、供应链证明和 adopter acceptance 一致。
intent: 发布 v0.2.71：交付已合并的能力暴露与文档修复，并以不可变公开制品验证安装、供应链和本仓库自治理。
outOfScope: 已保留的失败 tag 与历史 Work Item bytes

scenarioCoverage.expected: Package identity and tri-language versioning documentation consistently declare v0.2.71 while preserving v0.2.70 as the previous public baseline.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo metadata, version consistency, source archive, documentation, and release policy checks before tagging.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public v0.2.71 archives, checksums, SBOM, provenance, attestation, and release manifest agree with the immutable tag and downloaded bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After publication, download only public assets, verify digests, and run isolated adopter and N-1 acceptance without source or workspace fallback.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The published binary passes explicit-repository health checks and closure leaves a visible human Outcome, clean base, and exact branch/worktree cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Install the downloaded v0.2.71 binary, run inspect/status/doctor/agent doctor, then verify closure and documentation promotion.
